plan.rationale: Detailed WBS plus unavoidable repository execution cost.

risks: Task 7 strict recovery scope is within a provisional 12-hour baseline and supports Codex human sources only; retain calibration uncertainty.
Standalone producer issue kburson/ai-peer-review#197 must deliver verified commit/package/digest before consumer Develop; no cross-repository blocked-by injection.
Protected append-only retention provisioning and real native authority/OS incarnation may refuse unsupported hosts.
Managed serialization cannot supply global multi-object CAS against arbitrary external edits.
Legacy precedence/consumer inventory and full-body budgets can refuse enrollment; no protected prose truncation.

Scope baselines include normal implementation/verification/review; rubric breadth and unavoidable repository cost produce a separately calibrated human Plan estimate, not measured execution or the AI forecast.
The 60-minute execution allowance is a conservative planning assumption across new integration/packed-consumer/final checks, not a benchmark result.

testPlan.isolation: Disposable Git remotes, isolated GitHub transports and packed-producer consumer; exact-SHA final repository/CI gates
